army_rule_description: Units from your army with the Blessings of Khorne ability retain that ability and gain Slaughterers' Glory. At the start of the battle round, when making a Blessings of Khorne roll: roll four D6 instead of eight D6; you can activate only one Blessing of Khorne per battle round, instead of up to two.

detachments.detachment_rule_description: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit from your army declares a charge, each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Chosen of Khorne
enhancements.description: Once the bearer has destroyed one or more enemy units, until the end of the battle, each time you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll all of the dice. If you do, you must re-roll every die.

enhancements.name: Battle Lust
enhancements.description: Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if the bearer was the target of one or more of those attacks, it can make a Battle Lust move. Roll one D6; the bearer can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, the bearer can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Terrifying Screams
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next Command phase, subtract 1 from Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Rage
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army (excluding JAKHAL units) opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.effect: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, until the start of your next Movement phase, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in it makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Savage Resilience
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of that attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Cowards' Bane
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army (excluding JAKHAL units) within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit Falls Back, models in it must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. If that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

allowed_units.conditional_limit: Shared pool: up to 2 total characters
Shared pool: up to 2 total characters
Combined total of Jakhals units cannot exceed the number of Khorne Berzerkers units

mustering_rules.description: You can include up to 2 of the following units: Kharn The Betrayer, Master of Executions.
Up to 3 Khorne Berzerkers units (5 or 10 models). Up to 3 Jakhals units (10 models). The combined total of Jakhals units cannot exceed the number of Khorne Berzerkers units.
Up to 1 Eightbound (3 models) and up to 1 Exalted Eightbound (3 models).
Up to 1 Chaos Spawn (2 models) and up to 1 Chaos Terminators (5 models).
Do not split Jakhals units into separate units during the Form Boarding Squads step.
Kharn The Betrayer loses The Betrayer.
Chaos Terminators can perform the Secure Site Tactical Manoeuvre as if they had the BATTLELINE keyword.

abilities.name: Blood Surge
abilities.description: In your opponent's Shooting phase, each time an enemy unit has shot, if any models from this unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a Blood Surge move. Roll one D6 and add 2; models in this unit move up to that many inches, but the unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. This unit cannot make a Blood Surge move while it is Battle-shocked or within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and can only make one Blood Surge move per phase. Lost in Boarding Butchers Boarding Actions.

Each time you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, roll one additional D6 for each Bloodshed point you have, after which all your Bloodshed points are lost.
